connector.name: Htag Spatial
connector.registryDescription: HTAG H3 spatial tools for price/rent, indicators, geometry, and concordance.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.htagai.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.htagai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Optional HTAG API key for headless / server-to-server clients, issued from the Developer Portal (https://developer.htagai.com). Interactive MCP clients should use OAuth 2.0, which is discovered from the MCP URL and supports Dynamic Client Registration with authorization-code + PKCE - no API key or pre-created OAuth client required. See https://developer.htagai.com/agents-mcp.
